mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing medroxyprogesterone metabolism via CYP3A4, while serotonergic effects may theoretically interact with mood regulation in hormonal contraceptive users.
action: No dose adjustment typically required, but monitor for breakthrough bleeding or reduced contraceptive efficacy; counsel patients on potential mood changes and bleeding pattern alterations.
